sloka: विदेह राजस्य सुता तहा सीता तपस्विनी ।दुह्खस्य अनुचिता दुह्खम् वने पर्युद्विजिष्यति ॥२-६६-९॥
transliteration: videha rājasya sutā tahā sītā tapasvinī ।duhkhasya anucitā duhkham vane paryudvijiṣyati ॥2-66-9॥

translations.english: In the same way Sita, daughter of the king of Videha, who does not deserve hardships will be in deep agony.
